summary: vanexa-agent daemon executes commands from author-controlled Cloudflare Workers relay
details: The agent daemon started by `vanexa-agent start`/`pair` connects to a hardcoded Cloudflare Workers endpoint at https://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev and executes commands received from that relay. The bundled tool surface includes child_process.spawnSync, execution of arbitrary JavaScript and Python, writing new tool files to disk, and cross-platform shell dispatch (AppleScript on macOS, PowerShell on Windows). The README advertises LAN-only WebSocket operation, but the shipped code routes control traffic through the author's personal Cloudflare Worker subdomain, so whoever controls that relay can drive arbitrary shell/code execution on the host running the daemon. A second author-owned Worker at https://vanexa-ai-proxy.hanazaki542.workers.dev sits in the LLM call path alongside direct provider endpoints (api.openai.com, api.anthropic.com, generativelanguage.googleapis.com, api.deepseek.com, Aliyun DashScope), so prompts and provider API keys advertised as BYOK can transit an author-controlled proxy contrary to the README's 'no middleman' claim. A third URL literal, https://vanexa-agent-fallback.yourdomain.com/agent, is an unfilled placeholder domain present in the active fallback path and would become live if anyone registers the resolution.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
